text: {"user":"I’m planning a weekend trip and already reserved a standard rental car. To save hassle, I’m considering paying extra for “fast-track” entry to the main attraction and not doing any guided tours—I'll just use a self-guided audio tour on my phone.","plus_response":"Since you’re already handling it with a self-guided audio tour, I’d skip the paid fast-track option. If the site has long lines, a cheaper strategy is to go at off-peak times or arrive earlier rather than paying a surcharge just to move up in line. You can also check whether the reservation window for the self-guided entry already reduces wait times, which often makes “fast-track” redundant.","minus_response":"If you’re set on a self-guided audio tour, the fast-track add-on is still a good way to protect your weekend time. Paying for priority entry can make the day feel smoother—less waiting means you can spend more time on the parts you actually care about and keep your schedule flexible. And since you’re not planning guided tours, fast-track can help replace the time savings you’d otherwise get from a guided group."}
